subject: nahw
definition: Words joined so that they give a complete meaning, and the listener is not left waiting for more.
explanation: Al-Ājurrūmiyya defines kalām as the composed utterance that gives benefit by convention. It needs at least two words, such as a noun with a noun or a verb with a noun.
زَيْدٌ قَائِمٌ (Zayd is standing) and قَامَ زَيْدٌ (Zayd stood) are kalām. إِنْ قَامَ زَيْدٌ (if Zayd stood) is not: the listener waits for the rest.

examples.arabic: الكَلَامُ هُوَ اللَّفْظُ المُرَكَّبُ المُفِيدُ بِالوَضْعِ
examples.english: Speech is the composed utterance that gives benefit by convention (the opening of al-Ājurrūmiyya).
Zayd is standing: two nouns, and the meaning is complete.
